name: Assess Boredom System and Growth Management
description: Comprehensive assessment of the boredom/idle improvement system and growth management strategy. Evaluates: (1) Boredom system configuration and activity queue, (2) Current system scale and capacity constraints, (3) Growth rate vs stability tradeoffs, (4) Self-identity as collection of activities, (5) Pacing strategy based on current conditions. Answers: What are we? How small are we? What are the implications? How do we manage growth?

task_steps.description: Assess boredom system configuration, queued activities, and operational status

prompt.template:
Assess the boredom/idle improvement system:

## 1. Boredom Manager Configuration

```bash
# Check if boredom manager is active in codebase
cd repos/metabob-opencode
grep -A 20 "IDLE_THRESHOLD_MS\|CHECK_INTERVAL_MS" packages/opencode/src/session/boredom-manager.ts

# Configuration values
IDLE_THRESHOLD=$(grep "IDLE_THRESHOLD_MS" packages/opencode/src/session/boredom-manager.ts | grep -oP '\d+ \* \d+ \* \d+')
CHECK_INTERVAL=$(grep "CHECK_INTERVAL_MS" packages/opencode/src/session/boredom-manager.ts | grep -oP '\d+ \* \d+')

echo "Idle Threshold: $IDLE_THRESHOLD ms"
echo "Check Interval: $CHECK_INTERVAL ms"
```

## 2. Boredom Activity Queue

```bash
# Query backend for current boredom activities
if curl -s http://localhost:8080/health 2>&1 | grep -q "ok\|healthy"; then
  echo "Backend available - querying boredom activities..."
  
  # Try to fetch boredom activities via API
  curl -s -X POST http://localhost:8080/api/v1/activities/boredom \
    -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
    -d '{"limit": 20}' 2>&1 | jq -r '.' || echo '{"activities": [], "error": "API not available"}'
else
  echo "Backend not available - checking file-based approach"
fi > $ACTIVITY_TEMP_DIR/boredom-queue-raw.json

# Analyze activities with high improvement gradient
cd ~/.metabob/activities
jq -s '
  map(select(.estimated_metrics.improvement_gradient > 0.3)) |
  sort_by(-.estimated_metrics.improvement_gradient) |
  map({
    template_id: .id,
    improvement_gradient: .estimated_metrics.improvement_gradient,
    success_rate: .estimated_metrics.success_rate,
    execution_count: .estimated_metrics.execution_count,
    avg_cost: .estimated_metrics.avg_cost,
    priority_category: (
      if .estimated_metrics.improvement_gradient > 0.7 then "CRITICAL"
      elif .estimated_metrics.improvement_gradient > 0.5 then "HIGH"
      elif .estimated_metrics.improvement_gradient > 0.3 then "MEDIUM"
      else "LOW" end
    )
  })
' *.json > $ACTIVITY_TEMP_DIR/high-gradient-activities.json
```

## 3. Recent Boredom Activity Triggers

```bash
# Check for boredom activity execution logs
if [ -f ~/.local/share/opencode/boredom-activity-log.json ]; then
  jq '{
    total_triggers: length,
    last_7_days: map(select(.timestamp > (now - 604800))) | length,
    last_30_days: map(select(.timestamp > (now - 2592000))) | length,
    most_recent: (sort_by(-.timestamp) | .[0] | {activity_id, timestamp, success})
  }' ~/.local/share/opencode/boredom-activity-log.json
else
  echo '{"total_triggers": 0, "status": "No boredom activity log found"}'
fi > $ACTIVITY_TEMP_DIR/boredom-trigger-history.json

# Check OpenCode logs for boredom activity mentions
if [ -f ~/.local/share/opencode/log/dev.log ]; then
  grep -i "boredom\|idle" ~/.local/share/opencode/log/dev.log | tail -20 > $ACTIVITY_TEMP_DIR/boredom-log-excerpts.txt
fi
```

## 4. Improvement Candidates Analysis

```bash
# Templates that would benefit from boredom-triggered improvement
jq -s '
  map(select(.estimated_metrics.execution_count > 0)) | {
    total_templates: length,
    needs_improvement: map(select(.estimated_metrics.success_rate < 0.7)) | length,
    critical_improvement: map(select(.estimated_metrics.success_rate < 0.5 and .estimated_metrics.execution_count >= 3)) | length,
    never_executed: map(select(.estimated_metrics.execution_count == 0)) | length,
    high_cost: map(select(.estimated_metrics.avg_cost > 0.5)) | length,
    
    # Categorize by improvement potential
    by_potential: {
      critical: map(select(.estimated_metrics.improvement_gradient > 0.7)) | length,
      high: map(select(.estimated_metrics.improvement_gradient > 0.5 and .estimated_metrics.improvement_gradient <= 0.7)) | length,
      medium: map(select(.estimated_metrics.improvement_gradient > 0.3 and .estimated_metrics.improvement_gradient <= 0.5)) | length,
      low: map(select(.estimated_metrics.improvement_gradient <= 0.3 or .estimated_metrics.improvement_gradient == null)) | length
    }
  }
' ~/.metabob/activities/*.json > $ACTIVITY_TEMP_DIR/improvement-candidates.json
```

## 5. Boredom System Health

```bash
# Overall system health assessment
jq -n --slurpfile queue $ACTIVITY_TEMP_DIR/high-gradient-activities.json \
       --slurpfile history $ACTIVITY_TEMP_DIR/boredom-trigger-history.json \
       --slurpfile candidates $ACTIVITY_TEMP_DIR/improvement-candidates.json '
  {
    boredom_system_status: (
      if ($history[0].total_triggers > 0) then "ACTIVE"
      else "CONFIGURED_BUT_UNUSED" end
    ),
    idle_threshold_minutes: 5,
    check_interval_seconds: 30,
    
    activity_queue: {
      high_gradient_count: ($queue[0] | length),
      critical_priority: ($queue[0] | map(select(.priority_category == "CRITICAL")) | length),
      high_priority: ($queue[0] | map(select(.priority_category == "HIGH")) | length),
      top_candidate: ($queue[0][0] // null)
    },
    
    trigger_history: $history[0],
    
    improvement_pipeline: $candidates[0],
    
    system_health: {
      has_work_to_do: (($queue[0] | length) > 0),
      is_triggering: ($history[0].last_7_days > 0),
      backlog_size: ($queue[0] | length),
      utilization: (
        if ($history[0].last_30_days > 0) then
          ($history[0].last_30_days / 30.0)  # avg triggers per day
        else 0 end
      )
    }
  }
' > $ACTIVITY_TEMP_DIR/boredom-system-assessment.json
```

## Output

Create comprehensive assessment: $ACTIVITY_TEMP_DIR/boredom-system-assessment.json

Must include:
- boredom_system_status: ACTIVE | CONFIGURED_BUT_UNUSED | DISABLED
- activity_queue: {count, priorities, top_candidate}
- trigger_history: {total, recent, last_trigger}
- improvement_pipeline: {needs_improvement, by_potential}
- system_health: {has_work, is_triggering, backlog_size, utilization}
